verifiedBehavior: Actual canonical applyUserStorageDelta with real-file SQLite commits/debits, logical bytes from canonical thingStorageSizeBytes and subscription-envelope validators.
Finite exact quota boundary, unlimited allowance, Int32-to-Long promotion, overflow and underflow refusal.
Caught quota failures roll back content, ledger and synthetic history rows atomically; synthetic rows do not prove canonical Timeline persistence.
Two actual store handles serialize competing allowance claims; exactly one succeeds.
Wrong owner/plane, counterfeit handles, foreign async context and expired native session refuse without Mongo fallback.
Persisted normal user identity is read from the same transaction using actual buildUserSecure fixture output; Character and unsupported ledger states refuse before exposing writable callback.
Ready ledgers missing optional storageUpdatedAt and normal metadata with a null Character field remain accepted.
Hosted userStorage import does not construct/open SQLite; child process rejects SQLite require while exercising existing zero/sandbox/session ordering.
unchangedMongoBehavior: Mongo mutation and deletion/reconcile algorithms remain unchanged. Allowance/ready-envelope/quota-diagnosis policy is extracted and reused; original helper exports remain available.
limitations: No user/runtime/provider activation, native UI acceptance, actual API signup/session or private CRUD acceptance.
Canonical Timeline repository and History adapters are not implemented; synthetic history rows prove transaction atomicity only.
Native Character entitlement inheritance, pending deltas, reconciliation and corrupt/underflow deletion recovery remain explicitly unsupported and must be completed before activation.
Native identity/subscription/session initialization, home/content-plane selection, Things collection adapters, required query/index/migration semantics and full API acceptance remain required.
The typed collection provider uses correctness-first scans, not Mongo syntax or production index performance.
